title: Kissed Polish Vegetable Lasagna
description: A cozy, nutty, and snappy Polish dish featuring vegetable stock cube, en-croute, and egg-free-friendly.

ingredients.name: Vegetable stock cube
ingredients.notes: Dissolve in 2 cups of hot water

ingredients.name: Spinach
ingredients.notes: Fresh or frozen, thawed and drained

ingredients.name: Feta cheese
ingredients.notes: Crumble or crumbled ricotta can be used as substitute

ingredients.name: Sour cream
ingredients.notes: To serve or mix with the duxelles

instructions: Cook the lasagna noodles according to package instructions.
In a medium saucepan, combine the vegetable stock cube and 2 cups of hot water to dissolve.
Add the mushroom duxelles and stir. Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Stir in the grated carrots and zucchini.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked lasagna noodles, spinach, and feta cheese.
In a greased 9x13-inch baking dish, spread a thin layer of the vegetable sauce.
Arrange a layer of lasagna noodles on top of the sauce.
Spread half of the noodle mixture over the noodles, followed by half of the vegetable sauce.
Repeat the layers, finishing with a layer of noodles on top.
Brush the top of the lasagna with olive oil.
Bake for 35 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the noodles are heated through.
